title: Psychology Facts
hook: Paid just $1 to lie, they believed it.
facts: In 1959, Festinger and *Carlsmith* had students do a boring task.
Then they told the next student it was fun, for *$1* or *$20*.
The *$1* group later rated the task as more enjoyable.
That's *cognitive dissonance*: the mind rewrites opinions to fit actions.
